header.cleanBody:
Showdown- (Opposing Start Step) The opponent chooses a Spirit they control and compares BP with this Spirit. Destroy the Spirit(s) with equal or lower BP. When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed, activate the following effect:

■ When your life is three or less, send an opposing life to the Reserve.
